headline: Oil Prices and Energy Stocks Decline on Potential Iran Conflict De-escalation
summary: Energy stocks including Petrobras, YPF, and Ecopetrol fell on November 4, alongside the USO oil fund, as market participants reacted to expectations of an end to the conflict in Iran.
why: Energy companies are directly exposed to global oil price volatility, which is heavily influenced by geopolitical stability in major producing regions like the Middle East.
